name: The Sprinter
tagline: Finds the way to the mainframe fast, keeps it open with Testers, and sends every bot it can into the hack.

build.desc: What the team's next megabyte buys

table.why: The way is open and two Testers keep it so: hack.
The way is open: a second Tester to hold it.
No way to the mainframe yet: a second Explorer to find it sooner.
A second Builder, to pay for the sprint.
The links found are rotting before they are used: a Tester.
Nothing else to buy: a bot into the hack, for when the way opens.
